target.description: Resolve the Instruction of Ptahhotep as an attributed ancient Work, the Prisse Papyrus as a later physical witness, and the Gunn historical English translation as a separate Expression/Edition/Item route.
required_properties: Work identity separate from attributed author-mask
Prisse physical witness and digital representation kept separate
Gunn translation responsibility and edition identity
layered FR, US, and unresolved MX rights evidence
acceptable_substitutions: an originating national-library record resolving the same Prisse manuscript units
an exact historical Gunn edition record with stable edition and translator identity
an openly licensed or public-domain digital object whose terms cover the exact selected layer and reviewed jurisdiction
